messages:
matt_sales: FYI: Solstice Therapeutics wants a POC next week. Procurement said they'll only sign an OF if billing comes from our EU entity, but legal flagged the MSA has US entity specified. They also pushed an SLA latency clause and asked for a HIPAA-compatible DPA addendum. How do we stitch this together quickly? @olivia_legal @rana_finance

olivia_legal: High level: we can do a single-signature OF executed by Redwood Inference EU Ltd for billing, but the MSA needs to be linked. Options: 1) re-execute MSA under EU entity (slow) 2) keep original MSA with US entity and add a 1-page linkage addendum tying OF to existing MSA + narrow cross-entity liability for POC. For HIPAA/DPA we can append our standard BA (business associate) addendum. Will need Solstice's DPA counterparty details.

rana_finance: From Finance: EU billing requires IBAN and VAT on invoice. We also need the legal entity name exactly as on the bank account. If we do cross-entity invoicing, Treasury needs an internal AR memo to show the intercompany link. Net terms? Procurement asked for net15. Is that acceptable?

trevor_solutions: Delivery note: POC will ingest limited PHI-like test records. If HIPAA flagged, we should ensure logging/audit in the infra and confirm BA addendum. We can also scope the POC to synthetic data to avoid BA requirements, but client insists on real data.

matt_sales: They provided Solstice EU GmbH, VAT DE987654321, PO#: ST-9922, want EUR invoice, net15. They said "we require BAAs for any PHI". Timeline: trial start Mon morning. They asked if e-sign is OK or must be wet-ink.

olivia_legal: E-sign is fine. We'll add explicit "Electronic signatures binding" clause and instruct DocuSign to capture signer name, title, and entity. I'll draft a 1-page addendum: - Link OF to MSA (US MSA remains primary) - Identify Redwood Inference EU Ltd as billing counterparty for OF only - Limited indemnity carveout (POC scope only) - Attach BA addendum with HIPAA language. Circulate redline in 45m. Need Solstice KYC and BAA signatory.

rana_finance: OK, finance can approve net15 for POC but need exec approval for shorter terms. Also confirm currency EUR and we need IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 (example). Invoice-bot please create provisional invoice ST-9922 for EUR 9,500 (POC fee).

docusign-bot: docusign-bot: Recommended envelope: OF + 1-page linkage addendum + BAA. Single envelope, Solstice signs first, Redwood EU signer second. Audit trail enabled. Template: /ops/templates/eu-billing-linkage-v1.docx

olivia_legal: Two quick asks: (1) ensure BA addendum references Redwood entity that will handle PHI (we should name Redwood Inference US Inc if infra and processing are US-based), and (2) include data processing subprocessor list link. I'll include both in redline.

trevor_solutions: We'll confirm where PHI processing occurs. If processing stays in EU region, we can keep Redwood EU as processor. Ops will confirm by EOD and update addendum accordingly.

matt_sales: Routing KYC + PO to you now. I'll tell Solstice we can deliver by Monday if docs are signed by Fri EOD. If we need exec sign-off for net15, I'll loop in Jaime.

olivia_legal: Good. I'll post redline in #legal-drafts and ping ops for DocuSign envelope. If anyone needs to tweak indemnity language for POC scope, flag now.

rana_finance: Noted. Treasury needs finalized executed OF by Fri 17:00 CET to make the first collection window. I'll standby for final invoice.

matt_sales: Thanks all — will update after Solstice confirms KYC and signs the envelope. :pray:
